# Implementation Plan: Fix Release Workflow — Tag-Based Builds & Dev Pre-release Gating

**Branch**: `fix/017-release-workflow` | **Date**: 2026-08-10 | **Spec**: [spec.md](./spec.md)

**Input**: Feature specification from `specs/017-fix-release-workflow/spec.md`

**Note**: This file was generated by `/speckit-plan`. Phase 2 task generation is handled by `/speckit-tasks`.

## Summary

Two focused fixes to the release pipeline:

1. **Tag-based builds**: In `.github/workflows/release.yml`, the three binary-compiling jobs (`build` matrix, `build-deb`, `build-rpm`) must `actions/checkout@v4` with `ref: ${{ inputs.tag }}` so binaries are compiled from the exact released commit — not the caller's branch ref.
2. **Gate dev pre-releases**: In `.github/workflows/cd.yml`, the `pre-release` job must run only on `workflow_dispatch`, not on every `push` to `develop`, since dev pre-releases have zero consumers and burn scarce macOS runner time.

## Technical Context

**Language/Version**: GitHub Actions YAML — no Rust code changes.

**Primary Dependencies**: `actions/checkout@v4` (tag ref support), `softprops/action-gh-release@v2` (idempotent asset upload), `googleapis/release-please-action@v4` (unchanged). No new dependencies.

**Storage**: N/A — no data/schema changes. Version state unchanged.

**Testing**: No Rust tests. Validation via live workflow runs (quickstart scenarios) plus existing CI staying green.

**Target Platform**: GitHub Actions (all runners — build matrix unchanged).

**Project Type**: Single Rust binary CLI tool with GitHub Actions CI/CD; `develop` (integration) + `main` (release) branches.

**Performance Goals**: N/A. The gating fix reduces wasted macOS runner usage on develop pushes (SC-002/SC-005).

**Constraints**:
- `release.yml` build jobs MUST checkout `ref: ${{ inputs.tag }}` (FR-001).
- `pre-release` job gated to `workflow_dispatch` only on non-main (FR-002); manual path preserved (FR-003).
- Release asset build (`build-release`) must keep running on `release_created == 'true'` (FR-004).
- Re-running `release.yml` for an existing tag must be idempotent (FR-005) — softprops overwrites assets.
- No consumer regression: `rgt update` (uses `/releases/latest`, excludes prereleases) and Homebrew unchanged (FR-006).
- No force-push, no destructive ops.

**Scale/Scope**: 2 files edited:
1. `.github/workflows/release.yml` — add `ref: ${{ inputs.tag }}` to the 3 binary-build checkouts (build matrix line 58, build-deb line 130, build-rpm line 154). The `release` (179) and `homebrew` (220) jobs do NOT compile binaries — they download artifacts / compute SHAs — so their checkouts do not need the tag ref.
2. `.github/workflows/cd.yml` — change the `pre-release` job `if` condition from `github.ref == 'refs/heads/develop' || (workflow_dispatch && != main)` to `workflow_dispatch && github.ref != 'refs/heads/main'`.
